name: 아귀
body_structure: 극도로 마른 팔다리와 비정상적으로 부푼 복부
silhouette: 바늘처럼 가는 목과 매우 거대한 원형의 복부, 비정상적으로 긴 팔다리
signature_motion: 배를 움켜쥐며 주변을 더듬는 듯한 기괴한 움직임
signature_vfx: 복부에서 새어 나오는 형광 연두색의 일렁이는 아우라
visual_en: A tiny 40px character with a needle-thin neck and a massive, bloated spherical abdomen. The skin is a pale, deathly grey. The eyes glow with a piercing neon lime green, contrasting against the dark, dishemented black hair. Thin, spindly arms and legs extend from the bloated torso, with sharp claws at the fingertips. A small piece of golden chain is wrapped around the swollen belly, glinting with a bright yellow light. The mouth area features a small smear of glowing lime liquid. The overall silhouette is top-heavy and grotesque, emphasizing the immense size of the stomach compared to the skeletal limbs.
pose_en: Cowering and clutching the bloated stomach with a ravenous expression
vfx_en: A pulsating neon lime green glow emanating from the bloated belly
motion_en: Twitching and lunging forward with hungry spasms
lore: 살아 있는 동안 쉬지 않고 부푼다(카리아처럼 — px64 · px88 크기 단계 판).
concept: 저승길 — 한국 저승 설화(저승차사 · 옥졸 · 삼도천 · 명부 · 염라). 무섭되 이 게임의 2~3등신 치비 도트, 어두운 돌바닥과 밝은 회색 바닥 둘 다에서 보이는 몸 색.

body_plan.body: A small, grey-skinned humanoid character with long black hair, glowing green eyes, and a large protruding belly adorned with a gold chain.
